hero.subtitle: AI sleep technology born from Japanese care. Real-time vital signs, restful insights, and quiet peace of mind for the whole family.

about.title: We build sleep technology that respects rest.
about.lead: Headquartered with a Japanese design ethos, SleepTech engineers connected sleep devices that monitor without intruding — measuring vital signs through the surfaces you already trust: pads, beds, pillows.

pillars.title: Japanese craft
pillars.body: Hardware tuned for stillness. We obsess over fabric finish, sensor placement, and the subtleties of restful design.

pillars.title: AI-driven insight
pillars.body: Edge sensing fed into a private cloud. Heart rate variability, breath rate, body movement — translated into actionable nightly stories.

pillars.title: Family-shared
pillars.body: Invite siblings, partners, or caregivers. Receive alerts when a loved one's vitals stray from baseline. Privacy-first, always opt-in.

products.title: Built for life's quietest hours.
products.lead: A growing family of devices, all speaking the same SleepTech language.

yumepad.name: YumePad
yumepad.subtitle: Sleep Pad AI
yumepad.description: Slip YumePad under any mattress. Non-contact ballistocardiography captures heart rate variability, breath rate, body movement, and bed-presence — feeding a private AI that learns your rhythm and watches over your loved ones.
features: HRV + breath rate (BCG sensors, no skin contact)
Real-time push alerts for vital deviations
Offline edge processing — your data stays yours

smart_bed.name: Smart Bed
smart_bed.tagline: The bed that listens, adjusts, learns.
smart_bed.description: A full smart bedframe with zone-controlled climate, gentle elevation, and integrated YumePad sensing — choreographed to your sleep stages.

smart_pillow.name: Smart Pillow
smart_pillow.tagline: Snore detection. Posture nudge. Quiet presence.
smart_pillow.description: Memory-foam pillow with embedded microphone array and micro-haptics. Detects snoring, suggests gentle posture shifts, syncs with YumePad and Smart Bed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how SleepTech ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information when you use the SleepTech mobile application, hardware devices, websites, and related services (the "Service"). We are committed to safeguarding the sensitive nature of sleep and biometric data.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: Account information: email address, encrypted password hash, display name, profile photo (optional). Biometric and sleep data: heart rate variability (HRV), respiration rate, body movement, bed presence, ambient temperature, sleep stages and duration — all measured by your SleepTech devices. Device information: device serial numbers, BLE provisioning credentials, MQTT identifiers, firmware version. Technical data: IP address, mobile OS and version, app version, crash logs, device language. Push notification: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) device token. Family sharing: email addresses of family members you invite, the sharing role you assign them.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to: (a) provide the Service, including real-time monitoring and family sharing; (b) generate alerts when vital signs deviate from your baseline; (c) authenticate you and secure your account; (d) communicate with you about your account or service issues; (e) improve and develop new features (using aggregated, de-identified data); (f) comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 3. How We Share Your Information
sections.body: We share information only when necessary: (a) with family members you explicitly invite, limited to data they need; (b) with service providers (Cloudflare for delivery and protection, Firebase for push notifications, MXroute for transactional email) under data-protection agreements; (c) when required by law, court order, or to protect rights and safety. WE DO NOT SELL YOUR DATA. WE DO NOT SHARE YOUR DATA WITH ADVERTISERS.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention
sections.body: Account and sleep data are retained while your account is active. After you delete your account, we permanently erase or anonymize your data within 30 days, except where law requires longer retention. Aggregated, de-identified data may be retained indefinitely for product improvement.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to: access a copy of your data; correct inaccurate data; delete your account and data (in-app, Settings → Delete Account); export your sleep data in a machine-readable format (in-app); withdraw consent and object to processing; lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. To exercise these rights, contact hi@sleeptech.me. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security
sections.body: We implement strong security: TLS 1.3 in transit; encrypted database storage; bcrypt password hashing; per-device MQTT credentials with topic-level access control; OTP-based email verification; restricted internal access on a need-to-know basis. No system is 100% secure — please notify us immediately if you suspect compromise.

sections.heading: 7. Children's Privacy
sections.body: The Service is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16. If we learn that we have collected such data, we will delete it. Parents who believe we hold data of a child should contact hi@sleeptech.me.

sections.heading: 8. International Data Transfers
sections.body: Our primary servers are located in Asia-Pacific. If you access the Service from another region, your data may be transferred and processed in jurisdictions with different data-protection laws. We use standard contractual clauses and reasonable safeguards.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies and Local Storage
sections.body: Our website uses minimal cookies: a session cookie for authentication and a preference cookie for language and theme. We do not use third-party tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies on this site. The mobile app uses local storage for offline cache and authentication tokens only.

sections.heading: 10. Third-Party Services
sections.body: The Service uses: Cloudflare (CDN and DDoS protection — sees IP and request metadata); Firebase Cloud Messaging by Google (push notification delivery — receives device token and notification payload); MXroute (email delivery for verification and password reset — receives recipient address and message). Each provider has its own privacy policy.

sections.heading: 11. Apple App Store Privacy Labels
sections.body: Categories disclosed in App Store Connect: Health & Fitness data linked to user identity; Contact Info (email) linked to identity; Identifiers (device ID) linked to identity; Diagnostics (crash logs) not linked to identity. Used for: App Functionality and Product Personalization. Not used for tracking across third-party apps or websites.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy. Material changes will be communicated by email and in-app notice at least 30 days before they take effect. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the latest revision. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance.

sections.heading: 13. Contact and Data Protection Officer
sections.body: Privacy questions, complaints, or requests: SleepTech, Email: hi@sleeptech.me. EU/UK users may contact our representative at the same email. We respond to all privacy inquiries within 30 days.
